pages.text: Armor created using the Philosopher's Stone and Origins.$(br2)The Origins of Faith, Justice, Wisdom, and Temperance create armor with unique effects.
Head armor that can be created with the Origin of Faith. $(br)In addition to the buff that allows creative flight, it grants regeneration 3 and resistance 2.
Body armor that can be created with the Origin of Justice. $(br)Reflects 100% of incoming damage and inflicts knockback and fire.
Leg armor that can be created with the Origin of Wisdom. $(br)It reduces movement speed penalties from blocks, nullifies slowing debuffs, and reduces hunger loss.
Boots that can be created with the Origin of Temperance. $(br)It nullifies fall damage and halves the duration of all debuffs.
